 Europa League Game Time Thread: Juventus vs. Stade Rennais
 Can Juventus make it three straight wins to begin the Europa League league phase?
 by Danny Penza Oct 22, 2026, 3:30 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link

 VIGO, SPAIN - OCTOBER 15: Guglielmo Vicario of Juventus reacts during the UEFA Europa League 2026/27 League Phase MD2 match between Real Club Celta and Juventus at Estadio Balaidos on October 15, 2026 in Vigo, Spain. (Photo by Jose Manuel Alvarez Rey/Getty Images) Getty Images MATCH INFO
 When: Thursday, Oct. 22, 2026.
 Where: Allianz Stadium, Turin, Italy.
 Official kickoff time: 6:45 p.m. local time in Italy and across Europe, 5:45 p.m. in the United Kingdom, 12:45 p.m. Eastern time, 11:45 a.m. Central time, 9:45 a.m. Pacific time.

 STARTING LINEUP
 Juventus starting XI (3-4-1-2? 3-5-2?): Vicario; Gatti, Bremer (c), Kelly; Celik, McKennie, Douglas Luiz, Koopmeiners, Cambiaso; Woltemade, Kolo Muani.
 Juventus bench: Neto, Pinsoglio, Boga, Kalulu, Alajbegovic, Lucumi, Sarr, Gonzalez, Cabal, Merola.
 Juventus manager: Luciano Spalletti
 Stade Rennais starting XI (3-5-2): Samba; Ait Boudlal, Cresswell, Rouault; Reynolds, Thomassaon, Rongier, Camara, Nagida; Dia, Al-Taamari.
 Stade Rennais bench: Lemaitre, Belazzoug, Oliveira, Cisse, Blas, Mayenda, Szymanski, Merlin, Do Marcolino, Nordin, Soumare, Frankowski.
 Stade Rennais manager: Franck Haise
 Match referee: Morten Krogh
 HOW TO WATCH
 Television: CBS Sports Network, TUDN USA (United States); TNT Sports 5 (United Kingdom); Sky Sport Uno, Sky Sport 252 (Italy).
 Online/Streaming: Paramount+ , Univision NOW, UniMás, TUDN app, TUDN.com (United States); DAZN Canada; fuboTV Canada (Canada); HBO Max (United Kingdom); Sky GO Italia, NOW TV (Italy).
